Do not use this function to encode text that might get executed as JavaScript code, only to encode HTML literals.

inputParameters.description: The Text to be encoded.

Do not use this function to encode text that might get executed as part of the SQL statement. Check the OutSystems Best Practices documentation for more information on building dynamic SQL statements the right way.

inputParameters.name: text
inputParameters.description: The Text to be encoded.

name: DiffDays
description:
Returns the difference in days between 'dt1' and 'dt2'; i.e. how many days have passed between these two dates:

- Returns a positive number if 'dt1' is smaller than 'dt2';
- Returns a negative number if 'dt1' is bigger than 'dt2';
- Returns 0 if the two dates are equal.

The Time component you provide in the parameters is ignored. The DiffDays function receives two Date Time parameters, and then replaces the Time component with 00:00:00. It calculates the elapsed time in milliseconds from the first date at 00:00:00 to the second date at 00:00:00, and then converts the difference in milliseconds into days.

Daylight Saving Time (DST) is ignored. The time zone considered for evaluating this function is always the UTC, regardless of the regional settings of the end-user.

The maximum supported value is (2^31)-1 days. This corresponds to approximately 5879489.8 years. If DiffDays(dt1, dt2) is bigger than (2^31)-1, you will get an unexpected value.

inputParameters.name: dt1
inputParameters.description: The first Date Time.

inputParameters.name: dt2
inputParameters.description: The second Date Time.

Returns the difference in hours between 'dt1' and 'dt2'; i.e. how many hours have passed between these two dates:

- Returns a positive number if 'dt1' is smaller than 'dt2';

- Returns 0 if the two dates are equal.

Daylight Saving Time (DST) is ignored. The time zone considered for evaluating this function is always the UTC, regardless of the regional settings of the end-user.

The maximum supported value is (2^31)-1 hours. This corresponds to approximately 244978.74 years. If DiffHours(dt1, dt2) is bigger than (2^31)-1, you will get an unexpected value.

inputParameters.name: dt1

Daylight Saving Time (DST) is ignored. The time zone considered for evaluating this function is always the UTC, regardless of the regional settings of the end-user.

The maximum supported value is (2^31)-1 minutes. This corresponds to approximately 4085.78 years. If DiffMinutes(dt1, dt2) is bigger than (2^31)-1, you will get an unexpected value.

inputParameters.name: dt1

name: FormatCurrency

The decimal point is specified using 'decimal_separator', while the thousands can be separated with the 'group_separator'. When rounding, the function behaves differently depending on where you use it: - In the application server, it applies the method round half up (rounds to the nearest integer, 0.5 rounds up). - In client-side logic, it applies the method round half to even (rounds to the nearest integer, 0.5 rounds to the nearest even integer).

inputParameters.name: int_separator
inputParameters.description: The symbol for the international code.

inputParameters.name: area_separator
inputParameters.description: The symbol to use as separator between the international code and the area code.

inputParameters.name: phone_separator
inputParameters.description: The symbol to use as separator between the area code and the phone number.

name: FormatText
description: Builds a Text output of the specified Text 'value', by limiting it to the specified 'max_chars' count. If 'value' has less than the 'min_chars' characters limit, enough 'padding_char' characters are added to expand the length to that limit. In this case, 'left_padding' determines where the padding should be added.

inputParameters.name: value
inputParameters.description: The Text to be formatted.

inputParameters.name: min_chars
inputParameters.description: The minimum number of characters in the output.

inputParameters.name: max_chars
inputParameters.description: The maximum number of characters in the output.

inputParameters.name: left_padding
inputParameters.description: Indicates in which side the Text is padded.

inputParameters.name: padding_char
inputParameters.description: The character to use for padding the string to the minimum length.

name: FormatDateTime

inputParameters.name: value
inputParameters.description: The Date Time to be formatted.

inputParameters.name: format
inputParameters.description: The formatting pattern.

name: EmailAddressCreate
description:
Returns a full email address string containing the display name (usually it's the name of the email address owner) and the email address itself. The resulting full email address may then be used in the Send Email element (action flows) or in the Send Email activity (process flows).
To build a list of email addresses use the EmailAddressesConcatenate built-in function.

inputParameters.name: name
inputParameters.description: The display name of the email address which usually is the name of the email address owner as, for example, "John Smith".

inputParameters.name: email
inputParameters.description: The email address itself, for example, john.smith@worldmail.com.

name: EmailAddressesConcatenate
description: Returns the concatenation of email addresses, or list of email addresses, into a a new list of email addresses separated by a comma (','). The resulting list may then be used in the Send Email element (action flows) or in the Send Email activity (process flows).

inputParameters.name: address1
inputParameters.description: The email address or email addresses list

inputParameters.name: address2
inputParameters.description: The email address or email addresses list

name: EmailAddressValidate
description:
Returns true if Text 'address' is a valid email address. Note that EmailAddressValidate("") returns True.
This built-in function implements the validation specified by HTML5 (https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/input.html#valid-e-mail-address) which has a practical approach to RFC 5322.

inputParameters.name: address
inputParameters.description: The email address to validate.

name: GetApplicationServerType
description: Returns ".Net".

name: GetCurrentLocale
description: Returns the name of the current language locale of the user session. The name of the language locale is used for presentation purposes and follows the RFC 1766 standard format.

name: GetDatabaseProvider
description: Returns the type of the Platform Database (SqlServer, Oracle or MySQL) where the module is running.

name: GetUserAgent
description: Returns the user agent, as indicated by the header of the HTTP message.

name: GetOwnerEspaceIdentifier
description: Returns the identifier of the module that owns the element that is being processed.

name: GetEntryEspaceName
description: Returns the name of the module that is processing the web request.

name: GetEntryEspaceId
description: Returns the identifier of the module that is processing the web request.

name: GetObsoleteTenantId
description: Method to return a fake tenant identifier for single-tenant modules in order to mimic Site.TenantId semantic from the 6.0 version

name: GetAppName
description: Returns the name of the app that is processing the request.

name: AddPersonalAreaToURLPath
description:
Returns a string where the Personal Area is added (if applicable) to the URL path set in Text 't' input parameter. This function enables you to run any page (or resource) of your module in the Personal Area without having to manually change their paths.
This function adds the Personal Area of the developer that is running the module to the URL path provided by the input parameter.

inputParameters.name: url
inputParameters.description: The url to add the personal area path to.

name: GetBookmarkableURL
description:
Returns the URL of the screen that is currently being processed.
The URL returned by this function is a complete URL with the format https://organization.outsystems.app/app/screen?param1=value&param2=value... 
Parameters and their values aren't included when parameters are optional and their values aren't set.

name: GetPersonalAreaName
description: Returns the name of the Personal Area where the module is currently running.

name: GetOwnerURLPath
description: Returns the URL path of the app that owns the element that is being processed. Note that this function does not return the complete URL but only the component containing the location of the resource within the domain and, if applicable, the personal area.

name: GetExceptionURL
description: Returns the absolute URL of the screen where the last exception was raised.

name: GeneratePassword
description: Generates and returns a password string of length 'l'. If 'alpha' is True the string can contain both digits and letters, if False the string can only contain digits. The generated password string is a random combination of letters and digits, or just digits, depending on 'alpha'.

inputParameters.name: l
inputParameters.description: The length of the Text string to be generated.

inputParameters.name: alpha
inputParameters.description: Indicates if the generated Text string can contain digits and letters or digits only.

name: If
description:
Returns 'true_return' if 'value' is True, otherwise returns 'false_return'.
The return data type of the function is the type of 'true_return' unless there's an implicit conversion from 'true_return' type to 'false_return' type.
When there's no implicit type conversion an invalid data type error will occur.

inputParameters.name: value
inputParameters.description: The condition to be evaluated.

inputParameters.name: true_return
inputParameters.description: The expression to be evaluated and returned when the condition is true.

inputParameters.name: false_return
inputParameters.description: The expression to be evaluated and returned when the condition is false.

name: IsLoadingScreen
description: Returns true only when invoked within a screen Preparation execution and only if the screen is loading its content. Otherwise, if the screen is just being redrawn, i.e. posted back, it returns False.

name: CurrentThemeIsMobile
description: Returns true when the current web screen is using a mobile theme.

name: CheckRole
description: Returns true when the given user has the specific role.

inputParameters.name: RoleId
inputParameters.description: The identifier of the role to be validated.

inputParameters.name: UserId
inputParameters.description: The identifier of the user for which to validate if role is granted.

name: CheckEndUserRole
description: Returns true when the logged user has the specific role.

inputParameters.name: RoleId
inputParameters.description: The identifier of the role to be validated.

name: GetUserId
description: Returns the identifier of the user that is currently authenticated with the server or 'NullTextIdentifier()' if the user is not authenticated.
